author: zhenggen-xu

**Description**

<!--
Briefly describe the problem you are having in a few paragraphs.
-->

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.  Download and install image:
https://sonic-jenkins.westus2.cloudapp.azure.com/job/broadcom/job/buildimage-brcm-201911/100/artifact/target/sonic-broadcom.bin

2.  sudo sonic-cfggen -H -k Seastone-DX010-25-50 --preset=t1 > config_db_t1.json

3.  sudo config reload config_db_t1.json -y

4, top

**Describe the results you received:**
```
admin@lnos-x1-a-csw03:~$ top
top - 22:24:38 up 24 min,  1 user,  load average: 1.96, 2.45, 1.89
Tasks: 225 total,   2 running, 222 sleeping,   0 stopped,   1 zombie
%Cpu(s): 37.3 us, 14.0 sy,  0.0 ni, 48.0 id,  0.0 wa,  0.0 hi,  0.7 si,  0.0 st
KiB Mem :  4031152 total,  1403868 free,  1462428 used,  1164856 buff/cache
KiB Swap:        0 total,        0 free,        0 used.  2284064 avail Mem 

  PID USER      PR  NI    VIRT    RES    SHR S  %CPU %MEM     TIME+ COMMAND                                                                                                                                       
10877 root      20   0 1595652 358152  62032 S 181.1  8.9   5:14.43 syncd                                                                                                                                         
11240 root      20   0  169220  33396   8396 S  20.9  0.8   0:33.96 python3.6                                                                                                                                     
 1266 root      20   0   88776  19596   3276 S   7.6  0.5   2:38.88 redis-server  
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Syncd should not use that much CPU (181%) here.

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

    **Output of `show version`:**

    ```
admin@lnos-x1-a-csw03:~$ show ver
    ```

linkedPullRequests.title: [201911] Syncd high CPU fix on Th/Th2 platforms
linkedPullRequests.author: abdosi
linkedPullRequests.body:
**- Why I did it**
To fix syncd high cpu on TH/Th2 platforms as reported
https://github.com/Azure/sonic-buildimage/issues/4827

**- How I did it**
Updated libsaibcm Debian package
**- How to verify it**
Verified after loading on TH platforms cpu usage gone down:

Previous:
 PID USER      PR  NI    VIRT    RES    SHR S  %CPU  %MEM     TIME+ COMMAND                                                                                                       
 2521 root      20   0 1512860 360452  63540 S 144.6   4.4   8:00.03 syncd  

After Fix:
 7500 root      20   0 1592420 350912  64184 S  45.4  4.3   3:50.99 syncd

comments.author: judyjoseph
comments.body:
The CPU utilization even after the fix for syncd is at 45.4%, looks high. 
Is it the same case with earlier release SAI as well ? 

@judyjoseph yes. even 201811 image show that much. This is one instance only usage keep on varying.
Before fix always >= 100%
